mandate: Capture Quality Assistant (pre-Ready guidance) + uncertainty microcopy for Result surfaces

capture_envelope.contract: EnvelopeVerdict is NOT exported by @pickle/shared-types on main (verified: only UNSUPPORTED_DEVICE screen state exists in packages/shared-types/src/states.ts). Defined a minimal local typed interface with capture-envelope-checker semantics: SUPPORTED/DEGRADED/UNSUPPORTED per dimension over {subject_visibility, subject_distance, stability, lighting}; dimensions are Partial so an unmeasured dimension is honestly absent, never fabricated. Additive-mergeable when a shared contract lands.
capture_envelope.ready_gate: readyGate() blocks Ready ONLY on UNSUPPORTED dimensions; DEGRADED shows guidance without blocking.
capture_envelope.live_source: envelopeFromReadinessEvent() maps the existing native readiness CameraEvent (state, jointCoverage, stableForMs) to the envelope. Lighting has NO live signal in this build, so the mapper never emits a lighting read; the 'Too dark' copy exists in the dimension vocabulary for a future native envelope checker but cannot be shown from readiness events.
capture_envelope.wiring: AnalyzeScreen working phase (camera source only) renders CaptureGuidancePanel from the latest readiness event, before Ready; envelope clears on stroke_detected.

uncertainty_microcopy.contact_line: We couldn’t confidently locate contact on this attempt, so no contact marker is shown.
uncertainty_microcopy.gating: uncertaintyNotes() is a read-only consumer of the EXISTING gates (contactMarkerPresentation, phaseTimelinePresentation, strokeIntent.resolutionBasis, overallScore); no existing Result evidence-gating logic was modified. Each note renders only when the corresponding gate already withheld the element. StrokeResult renders the block additively on non-abstained results only (the abstention ledger already covers abstained results).

measured.mobile_jest: 32 suites / 230 tests passed (was 30 suites / 214 per HANDOFF_V3; +2 suites, +16 tests from this workstream)

honest_negatives: Mobbin MCP is not available in this environment; NO new Mobbin research was performed. Copy and layout conventions were taken from the W8 Mobbin-researched Stroke Result surface already in the repo.
Lighting guidance ('Too dark') is defined but unreachable from the current native readiness events — no live lighting measurement exists; wiring it requires a native envelope checker.

The Ready gate is presentational: native still owns actual trigger arming. readyGate() mirrors the native readiness states (UNSUPPORTED dimensions correspond 1:1 to non-ready native states), so the surface never claims Ready when native would not.
Not verified on-device: pose extraction is macOS/iOS-only and no phone hardware exists here; verification is jest + tsc only.
